title: Chironomus sancticaroli generation test: A new methodology with a Brazilian endemic insect
author: Bernegossi, Cardoso, et al.

steps.title: Choose assay and set up beakers
steps.instruction: Select one of the six assay configurations (Table 1) and prepare the corresponding beakers:

substeps.instruction: Assay 1: 1 000 mL glass beaker, lock with tulle netting, add 50 g sediment, no test‑solution replacement.
Assay 2: 1 000 mL glass beaker, lock with tulle netting, add 50 g sediment, replace test solution (yes).
Assay 3: 1 000 mL glass beaker, lock with tulle netting, add 50 g sediment, replace test solution (yes).
Assay 4: 500 mL plastic pot, close with plastic lid, add 60 g sediment, replace test solution (yes).
Assay 5: 500 mL plastic pot, close with plastic lid, add 60 g sediment, replace test solution (yes).
Assay 6: 500 mL plastic pot **or** 1 000 mL glass beaker, close with plastic lid **or** tulle netting, add 60 g sediment, replace test solution (yes).

steps.title: Add test solution
steps.instruction: Fill each beaker with the volume of test solution indicated for the chosen assay, ensuring the water depth allows larvae to swim and mate:

substeps.instruction: Assay 1: 500 mL solution.
Assay 2: 300 mL solution.
Assay 3: 300 mL solution.
Assays 4‑6: 340 mL solution.

steps.title: Introduce parental generation larvae
steps.instruction: Add the specified number of Parental (P) generation larvae to each replicate:

substeps.instruction: Assay 1: 10–15 larvae per replicate (3 replicates).
Assay 2: 15–20 larvae per replicate (3 replicates).
Assay 3: 15–20 larvae per replicate (3 replicates).
Assays 4‑6: 10–20 larvae per replicate (Assay 4–5: 3 replicates; Assay 6: 4 replicates).

steps.title: Feed larvae according to schedule
steps.instruction: Provide food to the larvae at the frequency and using the method specified for the assay:

substeps.instruction: Assay 1: Every 5 days, add 5 mL of a 5 g L⁻¹ solution.
Assay 2: Every 3 days, add 2 mL of a 5 g L⁻¹ solution.
Assay 3: Every 7 days, add 2.5 mg of powdered food.
Assays 4‑6: Every 10 days, add 2.5 mg of powdered food.

steps.title: Replace test solution if required
steps.instruction: For assays where replacement is indicated (Assays 2‑6), remove the existing solution at the next feeding time and add fresh solution of the same volume and concentration to compensate for evaporation.

steps.title: Adjust larvae density for filial generations
steps.instruction: When the first filial generation (F1) emerges, reduce the number of larvae added to each replicate to avoid competition:

substeps.instruction: Assays 1‑3: add 40–60 F1/F2 larvae per replicate (3 replicates).
Assays 4‑6: add 25 F1 larvae and 20 F2 larvae per replicate (Assay 4‑5: 3 replicates; Assay 6: 4 replicates).

steps.title: Sample larvae for measurements
steps.instruction: Collect larvae for length or other measurements according to the sampling plan:

substeps.instruction: Parental generation: sample 10 larvae from each replicate (assays 1‑6).
Filial generations (F1 and F2): sample 20–30 larvae from each replicate (assays 1‑6).
Additional sampling from the 4th replicate when present: 10–13 larvae (Assay 1) or 20 larvae (Assay 2).
